sentence: This project offers CRISPR gene editing help to researchers who study HIV in the brain and ways to suppress viral infection.
This project studies periodontal stem cells and looks for ways to use them to regrow missing periodontal tissues.
This project improves ways to measure the forces that drive cells moving together, in both in vitro and in vivo cell collectives.
This project studies how T cell production changes with age, genetics and environmental exposures in people linked to type 1 diabetes.
This project builds a technology that tries to find out how cancer cells inherit resistance to drug treatment when they divide.
This project sets up an imaging mass cytometry system that lets biomedical researchers look at tissue in fine detail.
This project tests whether ultrasensitive sequencing can find leftover tumor DNA in the surgical margins and blood of patients with pancreatic cancer.
This project builds dendrimer-based nanomedicines that carry drugs into prostate cancer cells, aiming to work better and cause fewer side effects.
This project tests the drug pembrolizumab in men with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer and checks their tumors to learn who responds best.
This project uses machine learning to look at different types of osteoarthritis in two population-based cohorts.
This project studies how cancers that have lost a certain tumor suppressor respond to double-stranded RNA and tests ways to treat them.
This project uses statistical methods on large databases to find out how antipsychotic drugs affect elderly adults with schizophrenia.
This project studies how a transcription factor affects exhausted T cells and the formation of memory T cells.
This project uses data from many people to look for genetics, circulating proteins, vitamins and medications that affect how mutant blood clones grow with age.
This project builds nanobody-based treatments that target lymphocyte activation gene 3 for cancer and chronic inflammation.
This project studies how two epigenetic reading proteins work in acute myeloid leukemia and looks for weak spots that treatments could target.
This project studies a group of neurons in the supramammillary nucleus to find out how they shape threat learning and avoidance behaviors.
This project studies how mesenchymal stem cells turn into transit amplifying cells in the adult mouse incisor and what role the trigeminal nerve plays.
This project studies how nuclear deformation affects chromatin remodeling, epigenetic changes, induced neuronal reprogramming and CRISPR-mediated gene editing.
